records.Subject: RTM-H-0007 L-03 again
records.Description: L-03 again on circuit 2. Same unit as February (00041055). Customer cold rooms in hall B affected.

records.CommentBody: On site 14:10. L-03 circuit 2, suction 1.9 bar. Circuit 1 normal. No oil traces at joints or valves. I am not F-gas certified so no gauges connected. Unit running on circuit 1. Needs certified technician.
Customer (Pieter Jansen) escalated to me directly, unhappy about the repeat. Sofie attends Thu 01/10 07:00. Jakub to arrange roof access and work at height permit.
Geen koudemiddel bijvullen voor ik er ben. EXV first.

records.Subject: Storing koelmachine dak hal B
records.TextBody:
Goedemorgen,

The chiller on the roof of hall B (your RTM-H-0007) is in alarm again since this morning, low pressure alarm, same as February. One circuit is off. Please send someone today.

Met vriendelijke groet,
Pieter Jansen
Facilities Manager | Maasvlakte Fresh Logistics

records.Subject: coupling noise GDN-C-0130
records.Description: Knocking at start and rubber dust in the coupling guard.
records.Resolution__c: Coupling element 41-5031 cracked at two teeth, replaced. Compressor room hot (vent fan off), customer informed. Monitoring.

records.CommentBody: Vastra bulletin for this coupling won't open on SharePoint, file is broken. Asked Anders Holm for a new copy.

records.Subject: L-03 kort RTM-H-0008
records.Description: L-03 circuit 1 kort na stroomonderbreking.
records.Resolution__c: Na stroomstoring pump-down niet afgerond, L-03 eenmalig. Gereset, beide circuits normaal. Serienummer buiten Nordkyl campagne.

records.Subject: P-07 GDN-P-0070
records.Description: Cavitation alarm, noise.
records.Resolution__c: Strainer dP 0.44 bar, cleaned (lots of vegetable fibre). Suction valve checked fully open.

records.Subject: Condensor reinigen RTM-H-0011
records.Description: Klant vraagt condensor reinigen, veel vervuiling door meeuwen.
records.Resolution__c: Condensor gereinigd, lamellen gekamd. Geen storingen in log.

records.Subject: Belt change GDN-V-0240
records.Description: Planned belt replacement, packing line.
records.Resolution__c: New belt 77-1012 fitted. Tension set, tracking checked over 30 min, ok.

records.Subject: E-15 sensor fault RTM-C-0120
records.Description: Compressor 0120 stopped with E-15, not restarting by itself.
records.Resolution__c: TS-2 sensor faulty (open circuit at connector). Replaced 41-2207. Running.

records.Subject: Scheduled oil change RTM-C-0121
records.Description: Scheduled oil change VRS-75.
records.Resolution__c: Scheduled oil change at 6,020 h since the last change, SynLube 46. Oil filter and air filter replaced. Interval is now 6,000 h with SynLube 46 (Vastra manual Rev C).

records.Subject: GDN-H-0014 quarterly PM
records.Description: Quarterly PM, non-refrigerant side.
records.Resolution__c: Coils cleaned, fans and electrical checked, readings from controller normal both circuits.

records.Subject: Bearing temp RTM-P-0060
records.Description: P-02 bearing temperature alarm.
records.Resolution__c: Bearing grease low (missed PM in April). Greased 25 g per bearing, temperature down to 58 C.

records.Subject: Firmware update GDN-C-0131
records.Description: Controller firmware update requested by Lena for all EU VRS-110.
records.Resolution__c: Updated to 5.2. Parameters checked after.

records.Subject: Filter drier RTM-H-0008
records.Description: Temperatuurverschil over filterdroger circuit 2 te hoog (4 C).
records.Resolution__c: Filterdroger kern vervangen (63-0410), circuit 2. Gelekzocht na werk, geen lek. dT nu 1 C.

records.Subject: Pull cord nuisance stops GDN-V-0241
records.Description: E-stop pull cord stopping the new conveyor without anyone pulling it.
records.Resolution__c: Pull cord tension too high after installation, switch on the edge of tripping. Re-tensioned to the marks. Tested.

records.Subject: L-03 circuit 2 RTM-H-0007
records.Description: L-03 lage zuigdruk circuit 2 na herstart na de winterstop. Klant (P. Jansen) belde 07:30.
records.Resolution__c: L-03 circuit 2 after winter restart, suction 2.1 bar. Visual inspection, no leak found, deficit under 10% of nameplate. Topped up 2,5 kg R-513A per KT-WI-14. Monitoring.

records.CommentBody: Unit stond ca. 6 weken stil (winterstop klant). Na herstart L-03 op circuit 2, circuit 1 normaal.
Controle na bijvullen: zuigdruk c2 3,3 bar, geen alarm meer. Afgesloten.
Linked to 00044102, L-03 again on the same circuit. Customer escalated.
EXV not checked at this visit. Will check it on site 01/10 before anything else, see 00044102.

records.Subject: PM postponed RTM-C-0121
records.Description: Oil change due, customer asked to postpone (stock count week).
records.Resolution__c: Postponed on customer request.

records.Subject: Belt replacement RTM-V-0230
records.Description: Planned belt replacement, belt worn through at edge.
records.Resolution__c: Belt replaced (Belton BX-20 belt, direct order). Tension and tracking set, ran 1 h.

records.Subject: GDN-C-0131 E-31 after storm
records.Description: VRS-110 down on E-31 after power outage during the storm. Marco on site at 08:00, cannot reset (needs HV).
records.Resolution__c: Reset by Lena Hoffmann per HV-PROC-07 on 03/12. Unit down 27 h. Customer ran on GDN-C-0130 only.

records.CommentBody: On site. E-31 active, panel reset not possible. Recorded alarm log and load at trip. Need HV technician.
Flying to Gdansk tonight, on site tomorrow 08:00.
Reset done, no repeat after 4 h. 27 h down because we have no HV-certified tech in Poland. Raised in the leads meeting.

records.Subject: F-gas lekcontrole RTM-H-0007
records.Description: Jaarlijkse F-gas lekcontrole.
records.Resolution__c: Geen lekkage gevonden, beide circuits. Logboek bijgewerkt.

records.Subject: NK-C25-14 EXV campagne GDN-H-0014
records.Description: Nordkyl campagne NK-C25-14 (SB-2025-014), serienummer in bereik. Twee keer L-03 op circuit 2 in 2025 met bijvullen.
records.Resolution__c: EXV replaced on both circuits with 63-1180 rev 3, filter drier cores 63-0410 on both circuits. Circuit 2 valve (rev 2) visibly sticking at restart. Excess charge recovered from circuit 2, both circuits charged by weight to nameplate. Controller software 6.9 -> 7.2 first (EXV service menu). Campaign label fitted, claim submitted under NK-C25-14.

records.CommentBody: EXV c2: positie bleef op 9% bij vraag 70% na herstart. Klep zit vast. Jakub helpt mee, goed leermoment.
Beide kleppen vervangen, c2 had 2,6 kg te veel na de bijvullingen. Oude kleppen retour Nordkyl.

records.Subject: Freeze protection GDN-H-0015
records.Description: L-04 freeze protection on the new NK-300.
records.Resolution__c: Customer BMS changed the setpoint to 3 C. Reset to 7 C with the customer's controls engineer, locked the local setpoint.

records.Subject: Oil carryover RTM-C-0121
records.Description: Customer reports oil at the air dryer drain.
records.Resolution__c: Separator element replaced (41-3075). Scavenge line clear. Checked after a week, no oil.

records.Subject: GDN-H-0014 L-03 again
records.Description: L-03 circuit 2 again, after the two-week summer shutdown.
records.Resolution__c: Chlodtech topped up 1.2 kg per KT-WI-14, visual check, no leak found, small deficit. Monitoring. Leak test to be planned.

records.CommentBody: Twee keer bijvullen sinds april zonder lek. Volledige lektest inplannen bij het volgende bezoek, niet weer bijvullen.
Ok. Chlodtech only checked visually again. Will plan the full leak test with them.

records.Subject: seal leak GDN-P-0070
records.Description: HCP-350 seal leaking, P-04 on the panel.
records.Resolution__c: Seal flush line kinked behind the coupling guard. Re-routed the flush line and replaced the seal with 18-0356. Dry after 24 h.

records.CommentBody: Flush line was pinched when the guard was refitted after commissioning. Rerouted with a wider bend.

records.Subject: RTM-H-0008 HP trip heatwave
records.Description: Hoge druk storing L-01 op circuit 1, buitentemperatuur 33 C.
records.Resolution__c: Condenser fan 3 motor failed (bearing). Fan motor replaced (Nordkyl, non-stock). Coils cleaned. Running both circuits.

records.CommentBody: Ventilator 3 draait niet, lager vast. Motor besteld bij Nordkyl, morgen geleverd. Unit draait op 1 circuit.
Motor vervangen, beide circuits in bedrijf. Persdruk c1 16,1 bar bij 31 C buiten.

records.Subject: Air filter alarm GDN-C-0130
records.Resolution__c: Replaced air filter 41-1510.

records.Subject: RTM-V-0230 drive overload
records.Description: Conveyor in hall A stopping on C-01.
records.Resolution__c: Product build-up under the belt at the tail pulley. Cleaned. Asked site to add it to their cleaning list.

records.Subject: L-03 circuit 2 GDN-H-0014
records.Description: Chiller alarm L-03 circuit 2 after the Easter shutdown (plant idle 4 days).
records.Resolution__c: Contractor (Chlodtech) attended for refrigerant work. Visual check, no leak found, small deficit. Topped up 1.8 kg R-513A per KT-WI-14. Full leak test to be planned at next visit.

records.CommentBody: On site. Circuit 2 suction low, circuit 1 normal. Called Chlodtech for the refrigerant side, they come tomorrow morning.

records.Subject: Tracking drift GDN-V-0240
records.Description: Belt drifting on the packing line BX-12, C-02 occasionally. Return idler bearing noisy.
records.Resolution__c: Return idler bearing rough, idler replaced with 77-0410 from stock. Tracking adjusted, ok.

records.Subject: P-07 on RTM-P-0060
records.Description: Cavitation alarm on the glycol pump in the plant room.
records.Resolution__c: Strainer full of plastic wrap fragments, dP 0.48 bar before cleaning. Cleaned, suction valve checked open. Alarm cleared.

records.Subject: RTM-C-0120 phase fault after power works
records.Description: Compressor 0120 down on E-02 after Stedin worked on the site supply overnight.
records.Resolution__c: Phase rotation and voltages checked, all ok. Reset, running. Customer to inform us before planned grid work.
